sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for display checks
sections.what: Loads the solar manifest, the budget unit helper, the display helpers and the UI mapper.
sections.why: Gives the test the formatting rules and the mapper to check.
sections.watch_out: Imports reach across the frontend and backend folders, so moving files breaks them.

sections.name: get
sections.title: Display rule checks and page binding checks
sections.what: Creates test records and checks budget, capacity, assessment and mapper output. Then reads the four list pages and the project detail page to confirm they use the shared formatter.
sections.why: Checks both the correct text and that every screen uses the same helper.
sections.watch_out: The page checks confirm the code text, not what is actually shown on screen.

summary: Checks that solar and renewables numbers display correctly for budgets and capacity, that missing assessments show clear text, and that the pages use the shared formatting helpers.
purpose: Keeps displayed money and capacity correct and readable, such as dollar billions or megawatts with AC or DC labels, and stops zero or raw numbers from showing.
why: Likely reason: report values come in mixed units and styles, so each display rule needs its own check.
how: Builds test copies of prepared solar records in the renewables industry. Checks budget text, capacity text for AC, DC and GW, the text shown when a value is not reported, and the UI mapping, which must not show zero megawatts or a confidence score. Then reads the page files and confirms they call the shared formatter. Ends with exit code 0.
inputs: Solar manifest entries, the display helpers, the budget unit helper, the UI mapper, and the page source files.
outputs: One pass message, then exit code 0.
risks: Checks of page source text break on harmless refactors. Expected values come from the report.
debug: If a text check fails, confirm the page still imports the shared formatter. If a number check fails, look at the display helper it calls.
